questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic signals are ahead. Be prepared to stop or proceed according to the signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that you are leaving a one-way road. Soon you will be on a road where traffic flows both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way entrance or exit. If you see this sign, turn around immediately. Traffic is coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that wet pavement ahead is slippery. Slow down because your vehicle will take longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed. Do not pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. You must merge with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a crosswalk area. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the intersection is clear and it is safe to pass through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn about construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians travel safely through these zones. Speeding fines are doubled in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending and warns you to prepare for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow has the same meaning as a red traffic light. You must come to a complete stop and wait for a traffic signal that allows you to turn in your desired direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles or flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a fluorescent yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black symbols alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: White signs with red and black markings are regulatory signs that enforce traffic laws. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
Only stop to yield to other traffic.
Vehicles will be entering the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red traffic light works like a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has a reverse curve—it curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: Orange warning signs indicate roadwork ahead. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road intersection is ahead.
